legacyNormalization: Missing unilateral means false; trainingType defaults to base; provenanceId defaults to null. Existing hamenoa YAML and warmup content are preserved.
sync: Reviewed snapshot; no live sync or runtime dependency on forceapp or Google Sheets.
executionIntegration: Catalog display only. Source game-and-inventory and tempoChoice values describe the source catalog contract; hamenoa does not consume them for load selection.
